STYLE: Same stylised 3D designer art-toy style and materials as the picture: a collectible vinyl-and-felt figure with adult proportions, long legs, a head only slightly larger than life, small eyes, thick expressive eyebrows, simple chunky hands, hair as one solid sculpted shape, matte soft skin with a slight handmade texture, clothes of real fabric at toy scale (knit, felt, denim, nylon) with a coarse soft weave. Character reference sheet picture: plain warm cream studio background, soft even daylight from the upper left, a soft contact shadow on the floor, nothing else in the picture. No letters, numbers, logos or badges anywhere.
TIMO: TIMO, the tall figure from the picture, 23: very tall and thin, long legs, stands very straight; dark brown skin, long oval face, round dark-brown eyes, thick straight black eyebrows, wide mouth, clean-shaven; black hair in a short flat-top with sharp edges, one solid shape. He wears a teal retro track jacket zipped to the chin with a cream collar, cream cuffs and ONE wide cream stripe down each sleeve; straight dark navy trousers that end above the ankle; cream socks; clean white trainers; a tiny square teal backpack worn high on both shoulders; a big chunky sunflower-yellow wristwatch with a blank cream face on his left wrist; a knitted scarf of wide teal and coral blocks with a cream fringe, knotted once at his throat, both ends short.
LUNA: LUNA, the short figure from the picture, 22: short and sturdy, she would reach Timo's shoulder, strong legs; warm light-tan skin, round face with full cheeks, a band of freckles across the nose, dark eyes, short straight eyebrows, a wide grin; a blunt chin-length bob with a full fringe, all coral, one solid sculpted shape. She wears an oversized plain coral retro football shirt with a cream V-collar and cream cuffs, worn loose; baggy light-blue denim shorts to the knee; cream socks pulled up; chunky cream trainers, a little scuffed; the same knitted scarf of wide teal and coral blocks with a cream fringe, worn loose round her neck with both ends hanging long down her front.
BIG: BIG YELLOW, the suitcase: a GIANT rounded sunflower-yellow hard-shell suitcase as big as a washing machine, wide and deep, standing upright on four small dark-violet wheels, satin finish (not mirror-shiny), two wide raised ridges running round its middle, a flat top, and one short fixed dark-violet grab handle on the top. No stickers, no locks, no telescopic handle.
CAT: THE CAT: a fat ginger street cat, round as a loaf of bread, short legs, cream belly and chin, a thick ginger tail held up like a question mark, half-closed green-gold eyes and a flat, unimpressed face; no collar. Made in the same art-toy style: matte, soft, slightly handmade felt texture.
